campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s01.xml.in:
Guerrilla hunter — 2 July 1941

HQ 8th NKVD Rifle Brigade, Estonia
CO General Kuznetsov

German troops are at the Estonian border, and armed Forest Brother groups are active behind our lines. Reports warn of an attempt to free prisoners held in our district, with the ERNA commando supporting the operation.

Protect the prison and find the armed groups before they can combine against it. The brigade is needed at the front; we cannot leave its rear open while the German advance approaches.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s02.xml.in:
Blitz — 10 July 1941

HQ 8th NKVD Rifle Brigade, Estonia
CO General Kuznetsov

The Germans are approaching Dorpat, but a train carrying important war supplies still has to pass through the town. If the defence gives way now, the train will be caught on the line.

Protect it and hold the town's approaches.

Local militia can reinforce the blocking positions while the brigade covers the railway. Keep the route open for the train even if the outer line must fall back.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s09.xml.in:
Sink the Tirpitz — 5 October 1941 (fictional mission)

Comrade, Tirpitz is anchored off the Estonian coast under harbour and air protection. We have no surface force here that can challenge her, and the Germans believe the anchorage is secure.

Three naval commando detachments have been assigned to you. Find a route into the anchorage and sink the battleship while the partisans delay the German troops ashore. Their command of the sea will count for little if our men can reach the ship.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s03.xml.in:
Hit and run — 28 April 1942

HQ Soviet Partisans, Lithuania
CO General Karotamm

The Germans have left a supply depot in Lithuania lightly guarded. They do not expect a large partisan force here, but nearby troops can respond once the alarm is raised.

Strike the depot, then bring the raiding detachments out through the withdrawal point. Surprise gives us a little time to do the damage; do not spend that time defending the ruins against the relief force.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s08.xml.in:
Revenge — 8 October 1942

HQ Soviet Partisans
Latvia
CO General Karotamm

An SS anti-partisan formation has moved into our Latvian district to rest and refit. Its detachments have brought terror to the occupied villages. For once, they are within reach before they are ready for another operation.

Find and destroy the three designated enemy formations. Close the approaches while the assault groups attack, so they cannot slip away and return to the villages after we withdraw.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s06.xml.in:
Operation Gypsy Baron — 15 June 1943

HQ Soviet Partisans, Belarus
CO General Karotamm

Our attacks on the railways have disrupted supplies for the German offensive around Kursk. The occupation command is now sending troops to drive the partisans out of the district and reopen the lines.

Hold the positions covering our bases and keep the railway unusable. Make the enemy fight for the routes his supply columns need, without allowing his clearing parties to surround the detachments.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s04.xml.in:
Rescue mission — 12 September 1943 (fictional mission)

An aircraft carrying an American politician to Moscow has come down in occupied Estonia. A British submarine is waiting offshore, but the passenger must reach the rendezvous island before the Germans find him.

Distract their forces in the south while the rescue group moves north towards Kuressaare. Take its port or airfield, secure transport and bring the passenger to the island. Keep him out of the fighting; the purpose of this raid is to get him home.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s07.xml.in:
Kill Bruno — 28 January 1944

The Germans have brought a railway gun into our area. Luftwaffe aircraft cover it from two nearby fields, making a direct attack dangerous. A Smersh team is coming to help remove that protection.

Seize and disable the eastern airfield while the team attacks the western one, then destroy the gun. Block the railway and hold the surrounding positions against the response. Check that every landing strip has been put out of use before committing the main assault.

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s05.xml.in:
Narva — 24 July 1944

HQ 2nd Shock Army
CO General Fedyuninsky

The Second Shock Army is preparing to break the German defence at Narva. Beyond the town, the Tannenberg Line and the coastal bases offer the enemy another position from which to block our advance.

Take Narva, force a passage through the line and occupy the ports, airfields and towns beyond it. Keep the following formations moving through the breach before the defenders can withdraw into a new continuous front.

Original Title & Design: Retreat to the Tannenberg Line by Stephen deJong

campaign.camp6bn5.scenario.bn5s10.xml.in:
August Storm — 12 August 1945

HQ Transbaikal Front, Manchuria
CO General Malinovsky

The advance through Manchuria is making progress, but the Japanese positions around Solon still bar the route ahead. Their defences must be broken before the following formations can pass through this sector.

Take Solon and the positions supporting it. Keep the roads open behind the leading troops so the Transbaikal Front can carry the offensive deeper into Manchuria.
